levels.surface: محمد بن الحسين بن أبي الخطاب

notes: The report is the compiler's statement on a book with no saying; its two isnads, split by «؛» and «و الحسن بن متيل», are read as two groups
«ما كان فيه عن سويد القلاء» names Suwayd at the head; the first route stops at al-Saffar and only the second writes Suwayd again, so no tail is taken
«رويته» is the compiler's own verb, not a written name; «رحمه الله» is an honorific
